**Motsenyat · 2025 · 健康人**

Modulating cerebrospinal fluid dynamics using pulsed photobiomodulation

*Brain Stimulation* · [DOI: 10.1016/j.brs.2025.102988](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.brs.2025.102988) · [阅读全文](https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf)

阅读范围：期刊正式版全文及原刊补充材料，表 1–5、图 7、补表 S2。

[加入研究对比](../../research/tpbm-compare.html?selected=motsenyat-2025-pulse-csf) · [按问题读](../../research/tpbm-questions.qmd)

## 怎么做

```{=html}
<dl class="tp-study-fields">
<div><dt>研究对象</dt><dd>45 名健康成人（20–32 岁）<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>研究设计</dt><dd>随机分配三种参数组合，受试者内多次扫描；经颅与鼻内交替、分开分析<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>波长</dt><dd>808 或 1064 nm<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>连续光 / 脉冲</dt><dd>10 或 40 Hz 脉冲；正文未给出明确的占空比数值<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射位置</dt><dd>右额经颅照射；另设鼻内条件<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>辐照度 / 功率</dt><dd>表 1 标称经颅 100／150／200 mW/cm²；鼻内 5／7／9 mW/cm²<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>光斑</dt><dd>经颅约 1 cm²；鼻内未确定<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射时间与疗程</dt><dd>每扫描段照射 4 分钟<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>剂量</dt><dd>表 1 经颅 12／18／24 J/cm²，鼻内 0.6／0.9／1.2 J/cm²，按原文记录<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>对照怎么做</dt><dd>扫描内照前和照后关光；无单独的全程假刺激组<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>观察指标</dt><dd>3T 双回波 pCASL 提取为脑脊液相关的 fMRI 信号<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>测量时间</dt><dd>照前、照中、照后各 4 分钟<br><a href="https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页，方法 §3.1–3.3、表 1–3｜样本、方案与照射参数</a></dd></div>
</dl>
```

## 结果怎么看

- 图 7 中照光时第四脑室信号范围平均约 +0.3%，关光后很快回落；曲线合并其他参数。（[PDF 第 1 页，图 7 与 §4.2.1｜经颅照射脑脊液信号](https://pbmfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Modulating-cerebrospinal-fluid-dynamics-using-pulsed-photobiomodulation-Brain-Stimulation-Basic-.pdf#page=1)）
- 参照辐照度下，四个感兴趣区的 40 Hz 系数 p 值为 0.12–0.71；模型包含辐照度与频率交互。（[补表 S2｜辐照度与频率的模型系数](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S1935861X25003900-mmc1.docx)）

## 对实验设计有什么用

若主要问题是频率，给每人做完两种频率，并在同波长、同辐照度下比较。把频率效应与频率乘辐照度的交互分开报告，预先定义感兴趣区和照中指标。
